title: A Rational Point Opens a Door
mathematical_role: Render the exact elliptic curve E5, a verified rational point, and the corresponding exact rational right triangle as two views of one arithmetic example while preserving the finite-window boundary.
learning_objective: Connect y^2=x^3-25x and P=(25/4,75/8) to an area-five rational right triangle, and remember that one exact witness is not a complete description of E5(Q).
literal_semantics: The plotted real curve is generated from y^2=x^3-25x over the recorded finite display window.
P=(25/4,75/8) and its reflected real point lie on the exact curve; P is labelled.
The right triangle has exact side lengths 3/2, 20/3, and 41/6.
The displayed area calculation equals 5 exactly.
nonliteral_semantics: The finite plotted window is not the whole real or rational point set.
Sampling density, line interpolation, panel placement, and color are rendering choices.
No additional visible point is asserted rational unless labelled.

notes: Curve samples are generated from the exact polynomial; the distinguished point and triangle are exact constants in the renderer.

renderer.version_or_environment: requirements/visual-pedagogy-render.txt; deterministic Matplotlib/Numpy raster renderer v4
reproducibility_notes: No randomness or external service is used.
The committed PNG is reproduced byte-for-byte in CI.
Rendering reproducibility does not establish rank, completeness, or BSD.

derivatives.role: current exact/data-derived raster review candidate; not live documentary asset

accessibility.alt_text: An exact real plot of E5, y squared equals x cubed minus 25x, marks P equals 25 over 4 comma 75 over 8 and is paired with a right triangle whose exact rational sides give area five.
accessibility.long_description: The left panel is a deterministic finite-window plot of the exact real curve E5 with the verified rational point highlighted. The right panel shows the exact area-five rational right triangle. Lower annotations state that the point and triangle are exact while the plotted window is finite and does not establish the Mordell-Weil group or BSD.

claim_boundary.strongest_visual_claim: Reproducible exposition of the source-stated congruent-number-five example and one verified rational point.

supersession_reason: Representation-layer repair preserves exact arithmetic content while moving the current candidate to a high-resolution deterministic raster composition.
